extractedText: Quant Trading — a primer for rigorous readers. Covers six core areas: (1) why quantitative thinking matters in markets, (2) time-series decomposition into trend/seasonality/cycle/noise, (3) mean-reversion and pairs trading with cointegration + z-score entry rules, (4) risk-adjusted return via the Sharpe ratio + annualisation, (5) position sizing via the Kelly criterion and fractional-Kelly heuristic, (6) risk management — stops, trailing, drawdown budgets.

metadata.subject: quant-trading
metadata.audience: rigorous reader, technically literate, new to systematic trading
